name: job-radar
description: Resume-matched job lead finder — upload a resume, search multiple job sources, surface leads that match above a configurable threshold.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @job-radar/api" "npm run dev -w @job-radar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @job-radar/shared && npm run build -w @job-radar/resume && npm run build -w @job-radar/matching && npm run build -w @job-radar/providers && npm run build -w @job-radar/api && npm run build -w @job-radar/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @job-radar/shared && npm run build -w @job-radar/resume && npm run build -w @job-radar/matching && npm run build -w @job-radar/providers && npm run build -w @job-radar/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @job-radar/shared && npm run build -w @job-radar/web
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/check-ui.mjs
